referents.why: 'them' (third masculine plural) is the dead frogs of Exo.8.9. The frogs are not among the candidates; the heaps are what they were piled into, not what was piled.
referents.category: object is an earlier thing not offered as a candidate

referents.why: The piling is done by the people of Egypt, who are not named. No candidate is a group of doers; the masculine plural candidates (heaps, houses) cannot pile.
referents.category: implied subject is an unnamed people

links.why: The stench is what the piled dead frogs bring about. R4 gives an act and then what it becomes as result, not as then.
The stench is the outcome of the piling of the dead frogs: an act, then what it brings about.
Reverses the order: cl0 comes first in the text.

none_fit.what: earlier non-person nouns (the frogs of Exo.8.9) are not offered as candidates, so a pronoun for them has no candidate to choose.
